import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np
from datetime import datetime

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'date': ['2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01'],
    'time': ['00:00', '02:00', '04:00', '06:00', '08:00'],
    'product': ['Cappuccino', 'Cappuccino', 'Tea', 'Latte', 'Americano'],
    'size': ['Large', 'Medium', 'Small', 'Large', 'Medium'],
    'price': [4.18, 4.01, 5.22, 6.37, 7.07],
    'quantity': [2, 3, 1, 2, 3],
    'payment_method': ['Credit Card', 'Credit Card', 'Credit Card', 'Credit Card', 'Cash'],
    'customer_age_group': ['55+', '35-44', '18-24', '45-54', '45-54'],
    'is_takeaway': [1, 1, 1, 1, 1],
    'total': [8.36, 12.03, 5.22, 12.74, 21.21]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Create datetime column for better time series visualization
df['datetime'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'] + ' ' + df['time'])

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-darkgrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Sales by Product and Size
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
product_size_data = df.groupby(['product', 'size'])['total'].sum().unstack().fillna(0)
product_size_data.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, width=0.8)
ax1.set_title('Total Sales by Product and Size', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Product', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=12)
ax1.legend(title='Size', title_fontsize=11)
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Sales Trend Over Time
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
ax2.plot(df['datetime'], df['total'], marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=8)
ax2.set_title('Sales Trend Throughout the Day', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Time', fontsize=12)
ax2.set_ylabel('Total Sale Amount ($)', fontsize=12)
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 3. Payment Method Distribution
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
payment_counts = df['payment_method'].value_counts()
colors = plt.cm.Set3(np.linspace(0, 1, len(payment_counts)))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax3.pie(payment_counts.values, labels=payment_counts.index, 
                                   autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors, startangle=90)
ax3.set_title('Payment Method Distribution', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 4. Customer Age Group Analysis
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
age_group_data = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
bars = ax4.bar(age_group_data.index, age_group_data.values, color=plt.cm.viridis(np.linspace(0, 1, len(age_group_data))))
ax4.set_title('Total Sales by Customer Age Group', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Age Group', fontsize=12)
ax4.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=12)
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# Add value labels on bars
for bar in bars:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax4.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height,
             f'${height:.2f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10)

# 5. Price vs Quantity Analysis
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
scatter = ax5.scatter(df['price'], df['quantity'], s=df['total']*20, 
                      c=df.index, alpha=0.6, cmap='plasma', edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax5.set_title('Price vs Quantity (Bubble Size = Total Sale)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Price ($)', fontsize=12)
ax5.set_ylabel('Quantity', fontsize=12)
ax5.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Add product labels
for i, row in df.iterrows():
    ax5.annotate(row['product'], (row['price'], row['quantity']), 
                 xytext=(5, 5), textcoords='offset points', fontsize=9)

# 6. Product Performance Metrics
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
product_metrics = df.groupby('product').agg({
    'total': 'sum',
    'quantity': 'sum',
    'price': 'mean'
}).reset_index()

x = np.arange(len(product_metrics))
width = 0.25

bars1 = ax6.bar(x - width, product_metrics['total'], width, label='Total Sales', alpha=0.8)
bars2 = ax6.bar(x, product_metrics['quantity'], width, label='Quantity Sold', alpha=0.8)
bars3 = ax6.bar(x + width, product_metrics['price'], width, label='Avg Price', alpha=0.8)

ax6.set_title('Product Performance Metrics', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Product', fontsize=12)
ax6.set_ylabel('Value', fontsize=12)
ax6.set_xticks(x)
ax6.set_xticklabels(product_metrics['product'], rotation=45)
ax6.legend()
ax6.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# Adjust layout
plt.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis - January 1, 2024', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.98)
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.96])

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
plt.close()
